Keep bath towels neatly hung and within easy reach while maintaining a clean, finished look on the wall in Mediterranean Blue, which presents a deep, sophisticated blue with subtle purple undertones, evoking the rich depths of coastal waters for a bold yet refined statement. The Carolina Collection towel bar is crafted from solid brass and designed for wall mount installation with concealed screw mounting hardware.

Highlights:
- Mediterranean Blue transforms this essential into a conversation piece
- Choose from 100 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Save space around the vanity and tub with a wall-mounted design
- Coordinate your room with the Carolina Collection for a matching Carolina set of classic bath accessories and traditional bathroom hardware

Specs & Installation:
- Product type: towel bar
- Collection: Carolina Collection (traditional style)
- Material: solid brass construction
- Mounting: wall mount; concealed screw mounting; mounting hardware included
- Dimensions: 36-Inch length x 2-Inch depth x 3.5-Inch height
- Weight: 3.2 lbs
- Finishes: multiple designer finish options available
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
